name: publish_send
title: Open publish review
description: Returns a no-effect workspace review handoff for supplied ApprovalItem/package ID(s). This model-visible handoff never creates a PublishRecord, queues work, resolves authorization, or sends anything externally. The ordinary product flow resolves and displays the exact package, destination, copy, and thumbnail in the workspace before a fresh server-bound final confirmation can publish; its app-only descriptor visibility is not an authenticated-MCP transport or human-review boundary.

approval_ids.description: Approval item IDs to review; multiple prepared channels are reviewed together by listing every approval_id from publish_prepare.approval_ids.
